meta.title: fix: optimize explore caching in ValidationService
meta.body_summary: Move findExploresFromCache call inside the compiledExplores undefined condition and use Object.values on cache to avoid unnecessary database queries when explores are already in memory.

perf_labels.notes: Devin moved cache call inside condition; PR closed by bot within 1.5 minutes without review or merge.

core_change_summary.description: In packages/backend/src/services/ValidationService/ValidationService.ts, moved the findExploresFromCache call inside the if (!compiledExplores) block and used Object.values on the returned cache object to avoid unnecessary database lookups when explores are already in memory.
